summary.value: After a beast, monster or plant you can see resolves a spell, learn it (recording the Species).

system.description: After a beast, monster or plant you can see resolves a spell, learn it (recording the Species). Hold up to (SL + 2); offensive casts use your chosen (INS + WLP) or (MIG + WLP). Variant available: Spell Buffet — read non-humanoid HP at (15 + half level) or less, execute one to learn all its spells, keeping (SL + 4). Chosen permanently.
